dedupe_keys.name: banca dati italiana degli effetti dello tsunami ited

description: Banca dati italiana degli effetti dello tsunami (ITED) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by tsunamiarchive.ingv.it. ITED (Italian Tsunami Effects Database) is the first database of descriptions of tsunami effects observed along the Italian coasts from 79 A.D. to date and was created as an extension of the Italian part of EMTC. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Italian Tsunami Effects Database (ITED)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include tsunami, tsunami effects, open data, historical tsunamis, Italian coasts. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
